shots.note: medium push_in: Daksha in his crimson dhoti and crown stands in his bright palace court under the title card, chin up with pride; a warm gold glow rises behind him on 'Brahma'.
medium pull_out: Daksha stands grieving in front; behind him faint rows of his green and violet sons stand in a lavender haze and fade away on 'every', leaving him alone.
medium crane_down: Narada with his veena stands calmly on the clouds, his hands folded together on 'never', with a faint knowing smile: no weapon, no blow.
wide dolly_right: Daksha opens his arms proudly at the left; behind him row after row of green-clad princes fill the palace courtyard, the far rows small and pale in the haze.
medium push_in: Three young princes in green dhotis and gold crowns stand at the front of their brothers, smiling; their name 'Haryashvas' appears above them.
two_shot tilt_down: Stacked: above, Daksha points out over the land as he commands; below, a Haryashva prince listens with folded hands and a willing smile.
wide pull_out: Rows of Haryashvas fold their hands together in agreement on 'agreed', the whole courtyard bowing at once in warm light.

establishing crane_down: Wide on a bright river mouth: the blue Sindhu runs out into the sea under a clear sky, and rows of small green-clad princes gather on the golden sand bank; the name plate reads 'River Sindhu'.
medium dolly_left: Closer on the front row of princes at the water's edge, hands folded toward the sea; a golden glow of the offering rises over the water on 'offerings'.
medium crane_down: Narada with his veena comes down through the bright clouds in soft rays of light; his name appears as it is spoken.
wide dolly_right: Narada walks along the bright shore with his veena toward the river mouth, the sea shining behind him.
two_shot pan_right: The window pans from Narada, one hand open in a question, to the rows of green princes on the sand, who turn to listen.
medium push_in: Closer on Narada asking: he lifts one hand on 'few' and spreads both hands wide on 'many', eyebrows raised in a teasing question.
close static: Close on three Haryashva princes: their smiles are gone, they glance at each other with knitted brows and closed mouths, the rows behind them just as unsure.
close push_in: Close on Narada's face: one corner of his mouth lifts in a sly smirk, eyes slid sideways toward the brothers.
wide pan_right: The window pans from Narada pointing outward to the wide earth beyond: hills, forests and a river winding away to far blue mountains.
medium tilt_up: A road of light climbs from the sand up to a shining mountain peak; Narada raises his hand toward it as golden rays fall on the summit on 'higher'.
wide push_in: Rows of green princes on the shore turn to one another with doubtful faces while the bright sky fades to gray-blue and a gray shadow of mist creeps along the rows.
wide dolly_right: At sunrise a long line of green princes walks away along a dusty road toward the sun, each one smaller and paler as the road runs to the horizon.
wide crane_up: The same sunrise road, now nearly empty: the last three tiny figures at the horizon fade into the light on 'saw', leaving only the road.
medium push_in: Daksha waits alone in his empty courtyard looking out to the road; his proud smile is gone and his eyes drop in sorrow on 'never'.
two_shot pull_out: Daksha and his wife Ashikli in her blue sari stand together in the courtyard; her name appears, and on 'thousand' rows of violet-clad princes appear behind them.
medium push_in: Three young princes in violet dotted dhotis and white uttariyas stand at the front of their brothers, smiling; the name 'Shavalashvas' appears above them.
two_shot pan_right: The very same shore and the very same pan: Narada, hand open, talks to rows of violet princes on the sand, who listen just as their brothers did.
wide dolly_left: On the sunrise road a line of violet princes walks away and dissolves into the morning mist on 'vanished'.
medium dutch: Daksha's face flushes with rage, red-eyed under heavy brows, as he thrusts his finger out on 'roared'; the sky behind him burns orange-red and the frame tilts.
medium pull_out: Daksha raises his hand in angry protest; behind him a village of empty, unlit houses stands with no one in it.
two_shot crane_down: Stacked: above, Daksha glares with clenched brows; below, Narada answers calmly with an open hand and a small serene smile.
medium tilt_up: Narada stands calm beside a road of soft light that runs to the horizon, his hand open toward it on 'choice': the path was there, walking it was theirs.
two_shot pan_right: The window pans from Daksha thrusting his finger in a curse to Narada, who is struck by a red ring of the curse and stops smiling.
high_angle crane_up: High over a wide green earth of hills and rivers, tiny green and violet princes stand alone, far apart, scattered across the land in the haze.
wide dolly_right: Under the first evening stars Narada walks on with his veena past a lamp-lit house that is not his; on 'home' he glances back at its warm door with a sad face and keeps walking.
close push_in: Close on Narada with his veena: on 'guide' a gold halo opens behind his head; on 'thief' a violet swirl takes its place and his smile turns sly.
